# Experiment I: the first pickup after reopening (generated by `exp_reopen.py`)

First in-season pickups of detected closers, eval years: 67 (27 customers); 66 on the open-season rate, the rest on the stage rate. Production projects none of them (held out as 'awaiting first pickup').

Days from the month-level opening to the first pickup: median 70, quartiles 52–88.

## Reference I1(0): closer rate × days since the season's 1st (or the clock, if later)

| Year | Pickups | WAPE | Bias |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2018 | 3 | 97.2% | +95.6% |
| 2019 | 5 | 56.6% | +41.8% |
| 2021 | 8 | 174.2% | +174.2% |
| 2022 | 11 | 142.0% | +120.0% |
| 2023 | 8 | 106.3% | -32.7% |
| 2024 | 11 | 137.2% | +102.5% |
| 2025 | 11 | 264.7% | +252.1% |
| 2026 | 10 | 252.6% | +208.6% |

Lag chosen on dev: **30 d**. Rolling picks: 2018: 0, 2019: 30, 2021: 30, 2022: 30, 2023: 30, 2024: 30, 2025: 30, 2026: 30. Odd→even picks: 2018: 0, 2022: 30, 2024: 30, 2026: 30.

## Is carryover identifiable?

actual = a × (rate × this-season days) + b × (rate × last season's open days after the last pickup); no intercept, customer-cluster bootstrap. b ≈ 0 means oil left at closing is not found at reopening; a < 1 means the season yields less than its calendar days imply.

| Window | a (this season) | 95% interval | b (last season's tail) | 95% interval |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| dev 2021-23 | 0.35 | 0.20–0.47 | 0.12 | -0.07–2.33 |
| confirm 2024-26 | 0.20 | 0.12–0.34 | 0.11 | -0.17–0.26 |
| all eval years | 0.30 | 0.19–0.37 | 0.13 | -0.01–0.90 |

Rows with any tail days: 56 of 67; median tail 17 d.
